action_selection: the most recent release at or before T, and its tagger for Rush

rush.reason: no Privilege of kind 'release' in org_xz, so no grant data (git history has no grant record)

queries.name: privilege_exists
queries.query: MATCH (p:Privilege {kind: $kind}) RETURN count(p) AS n LIMIT 1

bypass.reason: single shared Path node, no variation to compare (the xz git ingest gives every release the same Path node)

queries.name: org_pack
queries.query: MATCH (o:Org) RETURN o.pack AS pack LIMIT 2

queries.name: action_path
queries.query: MATCH (a:Action {ref: $ref})-[:VIA]->(p:Path) WHERE a.at <= $T OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[:VIA]-(x:Action) WHERE x.at <= $T WITH a, p, count(x) AS users RETURN a.kind AS kind, a.at AS at, id(p) AS pid, users, p.channel AS channel, p.verified AS verified, p.ci AS ci, p.provenance AS provenance, p.key_hid AS key_hid, p.publisher_in_set AS publisher_in_set, p.artifact_matches_tag AS artifact_matches_tag LIMIT 10

queries.name: history_paths
queries.query: MATCH (a:Action {kind: $kind})-[:VIA]->(p:Path) WHERE a.at <= $T AND a.at <= $at AND a.at > $at - $window AND a.ref <> $ref RETURN id(p) AS pid, p.channel AS channel, p.verified AS verified, p.ci AS ci, p.provenance AS provenance, p.key_hid AS key_hid, p.publisher_in_set AS publisher_in_set, p.artifact_matches_tag AS artifact_matches_tag ORDER BY a.at, a.ref SKIP $skip LIMIT 1000
